contracts.mmap: heap uses dma_mmap_wc; Cedar only offset0/at most4096 bytes
contracts.cache: WC explicit barriers; private ABI validates whole VA against file-owned imported buffer VMA; no arbitrary VA cache instructions

contracts.lifetime: all imported DMA buffers pinned until reboot, even normal close and possible partial address copy-out; total heap128MiB, individual buffer64MiB
